//: Syncpack governs package.json POLICY: declared versions, consistency, and
formatting. It does NOT enforce import direction — that is ESLint and
approve a manifest in which `contracts` depends on an application.
CI runs `deps:check` (syncpack lint) only. It never runs fix or format,
because a job that repairs a manifest reports on something the repository
KNOWN GAP: syncpack has no `optional` dependencyType — verified against
syncpack 15.3.2, which rejects it as 'not a built-in or custom type'. So
optionalDependencies are NOT governed here. scripts/check-workspace.mjs is
the compensating control: it checks dependencies, devDependencies,
and for inward-only layering. Do not assume this file covers that field.

versionGroups.label: Internal packages are always linked from the workspace, never a registry.
Every external dependency declares `catalog:` — the version lives in pnpm-workspace.yaml and nowhere else. Peers are exempt: they are ranges by nature.

semverGroups.label: Peer ranges stay permissive so a consumer can choose within them.
Everything else is exact — a range that moves silently changes behaviour.
